title: The Exhibit Opens Friday
tagline: A major exhibit opening in three days, a donor with strong opinions, and a question about one piece's authenticity that nobody wants to ask out loud.

wake_up.text: Three days until the exhibit opens. The catalog is at the printer, the gallery layout is finalized, and there's still a hundred small things that could go wrong.

choices.text: Review the full opening checklist before leaving
Trust the plan that's already in place

museum_arrival.text: The gallery is quiet before opening, pieces still being adjusted under careful lighting, everything half-finished and half-perfect.

choices.text: Walk the gallery

random_moment.text: The quiet morning hours before a museum opens have their own particular texture — a little different every day.

choices.text: The conservator mentions how well one restoration turned out
A lighting fixture in one gallery needs an unexpected fix
Morning light through the atrium hits the main piece beautifully

donor_call.text: A major donor calls, wanting their name more prominently placed on the exhibit signage than originally agreed.

choices.text: Hold the line on the original agreement, diplomatically
Accommodate the request to keep the relationship smooth

morning_installation.text: The installation team is placing the final pieces. One case in particular — the exhibit's centerpiece — is getting extra care.

choices.text: Oversee the centerpiece placement

authentication_question.text: A visiting scholar, invited for an early preview, quietly mentions a detail in the centerpiece's provenance documents that doesn't quite line up with known records. If they're right, the exhibit's biggest draw might not be what it's labeled as — and it opens in three days, already announced publicly.

choices.text: Halt everything and investigate the provenance immediately
Quietly bring in a second, independent expert before deciding anything
Proceed with an added disclaimer about disputed provenance
Proceed as planned — the scholar's concern is likely minor

auth_outcome_investigate.text: The deep dive into the archives takes most of the day, and it resolves cleanly — the discrepancy was a clerical error decades old, nothing more. The exhibit opens with its provenance more solid than it's ever been.

choices.text: Finalize the exhibit

auth_outcome_second_opinion.text: The independent expert confirms the piece is genuine within a few hours — quiet, careful, and exactly thorough enough without creating a public spectacle over what turns out to be a non-issue.

choices.text: Finalize the exhibit

auth_outcome_disclaimer.text: The disclaimer is honest and professionally handled, though it takes some of the shine off the centerpiece's unveiling. Transparency, even when it costs a little drama.

choices.text: Finalize the exhibit

auth_outcome_proceed.text: The exhibit proceeds exactly as planned. The scholar's concern turns out to be worth more than you gave it credit for, and it's the kind of thing that tends to resurface later, at a worse time.

choices.text: Finalize the exhibit

press_preview.text: A press preview walkthrough, journalists asking questions about the collection's centerpiece and its history.

choices.text: Engage deeply with every question, however technical
Keep answers brief and let the exhibit speak for itself

board_meeting.text: A board meeting to review final opening preparations — budget, staffing, the donor relationship from this morning.

choices.text: Give the board a fully honest account of today's events
Give the polished version that keeps things simple

end_shift.text: The gallery lights dim for the night. In three days, all of this becomes visible to the public for the first time.

choices.text: Head home

triumphant.title: The Exhibit of the Season
triumphant.blurb: Every call today was the right one, including the hardest one. This is the exhibit people will be talking about for years.

steady_hand.title: Solid Preparation
steady_hand.blurb: No scandals, no scrambling — just careful, thorough curatorial work, decision after decision.

ordinary_day.title: Another Exhibit Ready
ordinary_day.blurb: A full day of preparation, handled well. The next exhibit is already being planned.

burned_out.title: Running on Empty
burned_out.blurb: You made it through the day, but there's nothing left in you. This pace, deadline after deadline, has a real cost.

written_up.title: A Question for the Board
written_up.blurb: Something about today's handling is going to come up with the board. The exhibit opens. The questions about how it got there don't fully go away.
